dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible light-toned 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with sharp, high-contrast outer boundaries. The gradient transitions abruptly from a dark gray exterior to a light-gray perimeter, encircling a dark center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse to moderate density of small, solid light-colored clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the interstitial spaces between the larger ring structures on the mid-flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest 'O' rings on the upper mid-section form a roughly trapezoidal geometric relationship with the longest axis parallel to the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A reticulated network of high-intensity lineaments connects several annuli on the lower lateral region, creating a continuous web-like pixel pattern.
